name: Cleverhood
old_description: I tour for a living, and I can’t stress how nice it is when it rains to be able to pull this out of my production case not only to stay dry but it looks great. The cuts and style are very unique constantly have co workers asking where I got it. Fits true to size and the front pocket is so great for keeping your phone or wallet dry. So pleased this this product will be ordering more.
about:
Cleverhood is based in Providence, Rhode Island, where it operates an online store selling branded rainwear. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not disclosed in the available information.

The business designs and sells rainwear including anoraks, rain capes, and trenches aimed at cyclists and urban commuters. Products are marketed as combining form and function, with features such as front pockets for phones and wallets. The online shop runs on Shopify and ships to a long list of countries worldwide.

Customers include touring professionals, cyclists, dog walkers, and urban commuters. The brand has been recognized by WIRED magazine as the "Best Rain Jacket For Cycling." No specific B2B clients or industrial sectors are listed beyond consumer outdoor apparel.

Cleverhood positions its rainwear as a solution for stylish yet functional wet-weather gear, emphasizing unique cuts and practical details. The company participates in events such as the National Shutdown, indicating a degree of social engagement.
